display.purpose: Hero blocks and editorial openers only. Reserved for marquee moments.

headline.purpose: Page titles and major section headings on brand pages.

title.purpose: Card titles, modal titles, list-section titles.

label.purpose: Form labels, eyebrows, breadcrumbs, badge text.

shadows.name: card-hover
shadows.purpose: Ambient hover lift on clickable cards. Applied only on :hover.

shadows.name: control-float
shadows.purpose: Floating navigation controls (carousel arrows, sticky CTA).

shadows.name: control-float-accent
shadows.purpose: Hover state for floating controls — sage-tinted to confirm action.

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.purpose: Default easing for hover transitions and state changes.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Sage primary CTA. One per viewport, used sparingly.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #588f7a; color: #ffffff; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 8px; border: none; font-family: 'Inter Tight', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9375rem; letter-spacing: normal; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1), transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #4d8069; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(88, 143, 122, 0.4); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action — neutral surface, ink text, soft border.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: #ffffff; color: #18181b; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #e4e4e7; font-family: 'Inter Tight', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.9375rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #f4f4f5; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(88, 143, 122, 0.4); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Itinerary Card
components.description: Image-led card with destination photo, title, creator, and price. Flat at rest, ambient lift on hover.
components.html:
Dubai · 4 days

A morning on the dunes, then back to the marina

Curated by Layla Hassan

From AED 1,240-15%
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e4e4e7; border-radius: 24px; padding: 20px; transition: box-shadow 300ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1), border-color 200ms; max-width: 360px; font-family: 'Inter Tight', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: transparent; box-shadow: 0 14px 30px rgba(24, 24, 27, 0.1); } .ds-card-image { border-radius: 16px; overflow: hidden; height: 200px; background: #f4f4f5; margin-bottom: 16px; } .ds-card-image svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; } .ds-card-eyebrow { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; color: #52525b; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: none; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; color: #18181b; line-height: 1.3; margin: 8px 0 12px; } .ds-card-meta { font-size: 0.875rem; color: #71717a; margin: 0 0 16px; } .ds-card-foot { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-card-price { font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; color: #18181b; }

components.name: Discount Chip
components.description: Percentage-off badge on cards. Soft warn fill, warn text.
components.css: .ds-chip-warn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff5f3; color: #ff725e; border: 0.8px solid #ff725e; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.02em; }

components.name: City Filter Chip
components.description: Filter pill for city-page activity types. Active state adds a sage-tinted border.
components.css: .ds-chip-filter { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(207, 219, 229, 0.2); color: #435a67; border: 1px solid transparent; font-family: 'Inter Tight', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-chip-filter:hover { border-color: rgba(207, 219, 229, 0.5); } .ds-chip-filter--active { border-color: rgba(207, 219, 229, 0.5); }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Text input with explicit focus state — overrides project's global outline:none anti-pattern.
components.css: .ds-input-wrap { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-family: 'Inter Tight', sans-serif; } .ds-input-label { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; color: #52525b; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-input { background: #ffffff; color: #18181b; border: 1px solid #e4e4e7; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 14px; font-family: inherit; font-size: 0.9375rem; transition: border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1), box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #a1a1aa; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #d4d4d8; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #588f7a; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(88, 143, 122, 0.18); }

components.name: Navigation Progress Bar
components.description: 5px sage bar fixed to the top of the viewport during route transitions. The only place sage is allowed at full horizontal width — and only because it disappears in <500ms.
components.css: .ds-nprogress { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 5px; background: transparent; } .ds-nprogress-bar { display: block; height: 100%; background: #588f7a; transition: width 300ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); position: relative; } .ds-nprogress-peg { display: block; position: absolute; right: 0; top: -4px; width: 100px; height: 100%; box-shadow: 0 0 10px #588f7a, 0 0 5px #588f7a; opacity: 1; transform: rotate(3deg); }

narrative.overview:
Weelp's interface behaves like a quiet expert who knows the right operator in every city. Travel-magazine pacing, generous whitespace, confident typography, imagery that earns its place. The system steps back so the destination can step forward. Sage green is a signal, not a wallpaper.

This is a curated marketplace, not a search engine for hotels. Every itinerary, creator, and city is presented as if it were chosen, because it was. The visual system rejects the dense filter-rail aesthetic of Booking.com and Expedia, the pink-coral photo-card grid of AirBnB, and the purple-gradient SaaS dashboard cliché on the operator side.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained color strategy: tinted neutrals plus a single sage accent at ≤10% surface area on brand pages.
Editorial type pairing: Degular for display, Plus Jakarta for headlines, Inter Tight for body, Inter for labels.
Flat surfaces by default; depth appears only on intent (hover, focus).
Cards used sparingly. The default answer is whitespace and rhythm, not a card grid.
Imagery is destination-led; chrome and decoration recede when a strong photo is present.

rules.name: The One-Voice Rule
rules.body: The sage primary appears on ≤10% of any brand-register screen. If you find yourself painting a section sage, you are wrong: the section wants a sage signal, not a sage backdrop.

rules.name: The Single-Sage Rule
rules.body: There is one sage. #588f7a is canonical. The legacy variants #56947d, #558e7b, #51927a, #57947d scattered across globals.css are drift, not range. Replace them with #588f7a (or var(--secondaryDark)) on sight.

rules.name: The No-Pure-Black, No-Pure-White Rule
rules.body: Backgrounds are #f8faf9 or #ffffff. Text is #18181b ink, never #000000. Borders are #e4e4e7, never #000000 at any opacity.

rules.name: The Reserved-Display Rule
rules.body: Degular only appears in hero blocks, opener spreads, and editorial features. Section headings inside a page are Plus Jakarta. If every heading on the page uses Degular, Degular has stopped meaning anything.

rules.name: The Two-Sans Rule
rules.body: Inter Tight carries body, Inter carries labels. Do not introduce a third sans. Outfit and Inter (loose) are loaded by next/font but should not be referenced in new code; treat them as legacy.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: No shadow is applied to a non-hovered, non-floating element. Cards do not float when nothing has happened yet. Hover earns the shadow.

rules.name: The No-Decorative-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows communicate hover, focus, or float. They never communicate 'this is a card'. A card is a card because of its radius, padding, and content rhythm.

dos: Do keep the sage primary at ≤10% of any brand-register screen. The One-Voice Rule is non-negotiable.
Do use #588f7a as the canonical sage. Replace #56947d, #558e7b, #51927a, #57947d in legacy code as you touch it.
Do reach for whitespace before reaching for a card. If a section can be communicated with type rhythm and an image, do that.
Do let imagery carry the brand. When a strong destination photo is on screen, the surrounding type and color step back.
Do apply the Card Hover shadow only on :hover. Cards are flat at rest.
Do restore visible focus states on inputs and buttons. The global outline: none !important is a regression to fix, not a pattern to reproduce.
donts: Don't paint sage across a section background. Sage is a signal, not a wallpaper.
Don't use border-left or border-right >1px as a colored stripe accent on cards or alerts. The shared Absolute Bans apply.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text). Emphasize via weight or scale.
Don't ship glassmorphism by default. Blurs are rare and purposeful or absent.
Don't use the SaaS hero-metric template (big number, small label, supporting stats, gradient accent) anywhere. It is the first-order training-data reflex.
Don't stamp identical photo cards in a uniform grid (AirBnB anti-reference). Vary card width, vary which signal earns the eye.
Don't import the Booking.com / Expedia dense filter rail on the city page. Filters are progressive disclosure, not a left-rail wall.
Don't introduce a third sans-serif. Inter Tight body, Inter labels, Plus Jakarta headlines, Degular display — that is the set.
Don't use Degular on every heading. The Reserved-Display Rule guards it for marquee moments only.
Don't convey information through color alone. Discount, availability, and price-tier states must also use shape, weight, or text.
